bank-outage|w33300|f2400|a540.headline: Bank outage, 600 seconds duration, 2413 failed settlements
bank-outage|w33300|f2400|a540.narrative: A payment provider failure caused a system-wide outage lasting 600 seconds starting at tick 4001. During this window of 33,301 transactions, 2,413 failed to settle and 538 legitimate payments were wrongly scored as failures. Customer retry attempts during the downtime artificially inflated transaction rates, mimicking an attack pattern but resulting from infrastructure failure rather than fraud.
bank-outage|w33300|f2400|a540.action: Monitor for resolution of provider outage.
